name: Data Analyzer: Text encoding of a normal UTF-8 CSV file is recognised
objective: Shows the loader correctly identifies the character encoding of an ordinary plain-text CSV file.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly. A small made-up employee CSV file is written to a temporary folder.

steps.action: Ask the loader to detect the encoding of the saved CSV file
steps.expected: Reported encoding is either UTF-8 or ASCII (ASCII is a subset of UTF-8)

name: Data Analyzer: Text encoding of a Latin-1 file with accented names is recognised
objective: Shows files saved in an older Western-European encoding, with accented characters, are identified as such rather than mistaken for UTF-8.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly. A temporary CSV is saved in Latin-1 encoding.

steps.action: Write a CSV with accented made-up names and cities (Jose, Sao Paulo, Francois, Montreal) in Latin-1, then detect its encoding
steps.expected: Reported encoding is one of Latin-1, ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252 (all equivalent Western-European encodings)

name: Data Analyzer: A CSV file loads through the trusted local-file loader with the right rows and columns
objective: Shows a CSV file on disk is read, via the loader meant for local files (command line and app), into a table with the expected 10 rows and 7 named columns.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly. Made-up employee CSV saved to a temporary file.

steps.action: Load the CSV from its file path using the local-file loader, format csv
steps.data: Made-up employee file: id, name, age, department, salary, hire_date, is_active
steps.expected: Result is a data table with 10 rows and exactly the 7 expected column names in order

name: Data Analyzer: A CSV supplied as text loads into a table
objective: Shows CSV content passed as plain text (not a file) is read correctly.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.data: Made-up 10-row employee CSV as a text string
steps.expected: Result is a data table with 10 rows

name: Data Analyzer: A CSV supplied as an in-memory text stream loads into a table
objective: Shows CSV content held in an in-memory text stream is read correctly.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.action: Wrap the CSV text in an in-memory stream and load it
steps.expected: Result is a data table with 10 rows

name: Data Analyzer: Empty cells in a CSV are counted as missing values
objective: Shows blank cells are read as missing values rather than dropped or filled in.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.action: Load a tiny CSV with two blank cells and count missing values
steps.expected: Exactly 2 missing values are found in the whole table

name: Data Analyzer: A completely empty CSV gives an empty table instead of an error
objective: Shows the loader copes with an empty file by returning a table with no rows.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.action: Load an empty text string as CSV
steps.expected: Result has 0 rows and no error is raised

name: Data Analyzer: A CSV with only a header line gives zero rows but keeps the column names
objective: Shows a file containing column titles but no data is read as an empty table with the right columns.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.expected: Columns are col1, col2, col3 and there are 0 rows

name: Data Analyzer: The general load function handles CSV when told the format is csv
objective: Shows the general-purpose loader hands CSV content to the CSV reader correctly.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.action: Call the general loader with format csv
steps.expected: Result is a data table with 10 rows

name: Data Analyzer: An unsupported file format is rejected with a clear error
objective: Shows asking the loader for a format it does not support fails with an explanatory message instead of returning wrong data.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.action: Call the general loader with format xml
steps.expected: A value error is raised whose message contains 'Unsupported file format'

name: Data Analyzer: A semicolon-separated file loads through the local-file loader when the separator is given
objective: Shows files that use semicolons instead of commas are split into the right columns when read with the local-file loader.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly. A temporary semicolon-separated file is written.

steps.action: Load the file with the local-file loader, format csv, specifying the semicolon separator
steps.data: 3 columns name;age;city with rows Alice/30/Boston and Bob/25/NYC (made-up)
steps.expected: 2 rows and columns name, age, city

name: Data Analyzer: Quoted fields containing commas and quote marks load correctly
objective: Shows commas inside quoted text do not split a field in two, and doubled quote marks are handled.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.action: Load CSV text with quoted values
steps.data: Two made-up rows, e.g. "Smith, John" and a description containing ""quoted"" text
steps.expected: 2 rows are returned and the first name is exactly 'Smith, John' (only that value is checked, not the quote-mark text)

name: Data Analyzer: A CSV with mixed kinds of values loads with all its columns present
objective: Shows a file with numbers, text, true/false and dates loads without error and keeps its column names. Only the number of rows and the presence of columns are checked, not the detected data types.
precondition: Offline test harness; no network and no AI model; the data loader component is used directly.

steps.action: Load made-up CSV text with five differently-typed columns
steps.expected: 4 rows; all five columns present; int_col is 1-4, float_col is 1.5-4.5 and str_col is text, more, data, here.
